definitions.headline: the 10-year, flat-tax results are the signed-off horizon and are unchanged by Block E3.4; the 20-year and ageing results are sensitivities (variants)

variant_definitions.horizon_10_flat: 10 years, tax per registrant constant (signed-off headline)
variant_definitions.horizon_10_aged: 10 years, tax per registrant follows the age-earnings path

variant_definitions.horizon_20_aged_persistence_0.75: 20 years, age-earnings path, fixed yearly persistence 0.75
variant_definitions.horizon_20_aged_persistence_0.90: 20 years, age-earnings path, fixed yearly persistence 0.90
variant_definitions.horizon_20_aged_persistence_0.95: 20 years, age-earnings path, fixed yearly persistence 0.95

age_earnings_path.method: A registrant of the stage's target group sits in a 5-year ILFS age band; k years after registering the registrant is k years older and pays the mean statutory tax of persons of the stage's type (all persons / non-owners / owners) outside the formal net at that age. multiplier(k) = mean tax at age + k / mean tax at registration, k = 0..19. Registrants are spread uniformly over the ages of each band inside the group's age range; ages above 97 keep the profile of 97; deaths and drop-outs are covered by the persistence rate; no wage growth.

break_even_cost.definition: the programme cost at which ROI = 1: discounted revenue (mean / median / 10th-90th percentile of the Monte Carlo), by variant and discount rate
break_even_cost.statement_10_years: Asset pays back at any programme cost below TZS 1.83 billion (median; 80% interval 0.00-5.91 billion) over 10 years at a 10% discount rate
break_even_cost.statement_20_years: Asset pays back at any programme cost below TZS 1.81 billion (median; 80% interval 0.00-5.88 billion) over 20 years (age-earnings path, signed-off persistence) at a 10% discount rate

portfolio.note: Asset is excluded from the portfolio cost and ROI (no stated cost); its revenue is reported separately under stages.asset. Seed is in the portfolio as cost only.

new_tin_holiday_sensitivity.note: Finance Act 2026, First Schedule para 2(3) item 2: the presumptive tax is NIL for the first twelve months from obtaining a TIN for an individual who obtains it to commence a business (on application). NOT applied in the headline: the registrants modelled are existing informal workers and owners. Here the Enterprise stage's first year of revenue per registrant is set to zero (10 years, flat tax, signed-off persistence).
